decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app extends the firm's core dental practice software and its integration know-how, has a dedicated launch page as a new product line, and fits the strategic push toward digital, connected practices, so the firm can readily interpret early results and improve it through its own R&D.

The continuing education institute builds on the firm's existing training content and close practitioner relationships, which strengthens customer ties and knowledge flows, though as a service outside pure software it carries somewhat more uncertainty.

The remote screen sharing support tool directly supports the firm's established customer support operations at low cost and relies on capabilities it already holds, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
